purpose: All non-frozen Task10 family18+ boards with both actual key glyphs visible, not just the selected60. Opening refinement frozen before calls. Unknown is never losing or unique.

card.sentence: The clock is frozen; the tiles that would thaw it are locked, so the keys come first.
bites: The clock needs 17 moves and gets 18: 1 to spare.
2 tiles you must take on the way wait in the tray until after the clock: whatever the order, the tray reaches 3.
On the way the tray fills to 3, 3 moves with 3 waiting.
1 dig uncover a face-down tile while 2 wait (luck).

tray reaches exactly 3 on the fewest way to the clock
